questions.question: Why did David send messengers to the king of the Ammonites?
options: To declare open war on all the Ammonite cities
To show kindness because of his father's kindness
To collect the yearly tribute that was owed to him
To propose a marriage between the two royal houses
questions.answer: To show kindness because of his father's kindness

questions.question: How did the Ammonites humiliate David's messengers?
options: Shaved them and cut off their garments
Killed them and sent back their dead bodies
Robbed them of their gifts and gold
Threw them into the city's prison
questions.answer: Shaved them and cut off their garments
